title: install.sh: offer to wire the fr status line into each installed harness (Claude Code, Hermes, Codex, OpenCode)
body:
> **Long-lived tracking issue.** The Claude Code part can ship now. The other harnesses wait on upstream, so expect this issue to stay open until they catch up, with each harness checked off as it becomes wireable.

## Why

4.4.0 ships a status line (`plugins/super-fr/scripts/fr-statusline-claude.sh` plus the harness-neutral `fr-statusline-segment.sh`). The code works, but no harness uses it until the operator wires it up by hand, and `install.sh` never mentions it. To wire it on one host I had to:

1. read the script header and spec §5.B to find the intended path,
2. link `~/.claude/statusline.sh` → `~/.claude/plugins/cache/derio-net--super-fr/super-fr/current/scripts/fr-statusline-claude.sh` (the `current` symlink, so the link still works after an upgrade; a `…/4.4.0/…` target would stay on 4.4.0),
3. add `statusLine` to `~/.claude/settings.json`, which had no such key, so the link alone did nothing.

The spec's operator decision d1 said "ship a version for every supported harness". The installer is where that promise should reach the operator.

## Can the script be used by the other harnesses today? No, and the blockers are upstream

(Spec `2026-09-14-statusline-session-branch-design.md` §2.3 and §5.C–D, plus Codex, which the spec does not cover. Upstream status checked 2026-09-16.)

| Harness | Consumer for a command-driven status line | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | `statusLine.command` in settings | ✅ works now with `fr-statusline-claude.sh` |
| Hermes Agent | `display.status_bar.custom_command` | ⛔ not shipped: NousResearch/hermes-agent#109596 is still **open**. Also `fr hermes install` copies only `hooks/`, not `scripts/` |
| Codex (next in the harness pipeline) | `tui.status_line` / `/statusline`, but only a **fixed list of built-in items** (`git-branch`, `current-dir`, `context-used`, …; `codex-rs/tui/src/bottom_pane/status_line_setup.rs`). There is no custom-command item, and `raw-output` just means raw scrollback mode is on | ⛔ openai/codex#17827 "Customizable status line" (a Claude-style `command` hook) is **open**. The built-in `git-branch` can show the branch, but nothing can show the fr worktree or `no fr-isolation`. super-fr also has no Codex harness support yet (`fr models resolve --harness` lists only `claude-code \| opencode \| hermes`) |
| OpenCode | none | ⛔ no status-line hook: anomalyco/opencode#37464 is **open** (#30295 closed). The only option today is running `fr-statusline-segment.sh --format oneline --cwd <dir>` from a tmux/herdr status bar |

`fr-statusline-claude.sh` itself is Claude-only because it reads Claude's stdin JSON. The shared part is `fr-statusline-segment.sh --format oneline --cwd .`, which any future consumer can call.

## Ask

`scripts/install.sh` should find every harness installed on the host (it already checks for `~/.config/opencode` and `$HERMES_HOME`) and **offer** to wire the status line for each one, as far as that harness can use it:

- **Claude Code:** offer to set `statusLine` to the `current`-pathed `fr-statusline-claude.sh`.
  - `statusLine` is not a key super-fr owns, so follow the installer rules in AGENTS.md: write it only if it is **absent**, or if it already points at a super-fr status line (in that case bring it up to date). If the operator has their own status line, **never overwrite it**. Print the one-line change they could make instead, or how to call the segment with `--format ansi` from their own script.
  - `--uninstall` removes `statusLine` only if it still points at super-fr.
- **Hermes:** only offer once Hermes can read `custom_command`, detected from the Hermes version or feature, not assumed. Spec d5 is explicit that `fr hermes install` must not write a key Hermes does not read. When it becomes available, `fr hermes install` also has to copy `scripts/`. Until then, print "pending NousResearch/hermes-agent#109596".
- **Codex:** once super-fr supports Codex **and** openai/codex#17827 (or an equivalent command item) has shipped, offer to add the segment to `~/.codex/config.toml`, with the same no-clobber rule for an existing `tui.status_line`. Until then, print "pending openai/codex#17827". Optionally suggest the built-in `git-branch` item as a partial stand-in, and say clearly that it cannot show the fr-isolation state. The Codex harness work should add status-line wiring to its own checklist, so the installer doesn't have to catch up afterwards.
- **OpenCode:** print that there is no hook yet, give the tmux/herdr command, and link #37464. Offer wiring once a hook exists.

Behaviour:

- **Interactive:** one yes/no prompt per harness, with the exact change shown before anything is written.
- **Non-interactive** (`curl | bash`, CI, agent shells): **never prompt and never write** a harness's user config. Print a per-harness summary with the command to wire it by hand. (Same "no surprise writes when nothing is watching" principle as the artifact-migration gate.)
- Running the installer again changes nothing once the status line is wired.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Fresh host with Claude Code and no `statusLine`: interactive yes → `statusLine` is set; the next session shows branch and worktree lines
- [ ] Existing custom `statusLine`: left untouched, and hand-wiring instructions are printed
- [ ] Non-interactive install: no harness config file changes (mtime and content unchanged)
- [ ] `--uninstall` removes only a super-fr-owned `statusLine`
- [ ] Claude Code: shippable now
- [ ] Hermes: wired once hermes-agent#109596 ships (and `fr hermes install` copies `scripts/`)
- [ ] Codex: wired once super-fr supports Codex and openai/codex#17827 ships
- [ ] OpenCode: wired once anomalyco/opencode#37464 ships
- [ ] Until each ships: a clear "pending upstream" message with the link, and nothing is written
- [ ] Tests in the `tests/unit/test_install_sh.py` style; acceptance-matrix row; version bump (touches `install.sh`)
